title: Prescriptions Patient Safety Notice: Error Reports on a Non-Controlled Short Fill
content:
When the short fill behind a declined owed balance on a Kestrel Prescriptions record in the Non-Controlled Acute Prescription, Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription or Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription class has been reported as a dispensing error, the non-controlled error amount applies.

## Notice

The non-controlled error amount looks at the dispensing-error reports that name the short fill:

1. a report with the review outcome **confirmed** adds **1.00**;
2. a report still **pending review**, with none confirmed, adds **0.50**;
3. no such report adds nothing.

The error amount is added to the non-controlled decline credit.

## Combinations (hypothetical reports naming the short fill)

| Confirmed reports | Reports pending review | Error amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | any | 1.00 |
| none | 1 or more | 0.50 |
| none | none | nothing |

A report whose outcome is not confirmed, with no other report naming the short fill, adds nothing. Reports naming a different fill are not looked at.
